source_text: Ἔνθεν δὲ καὶ ἄθεοι κεκλήμεθα· καὶ ὁμολογοῦμεν τῶν τοιούτων νομιζομένων θεῶν ἄθεοι εἶναι, ἀλλ᾿ οὐχὶ τοῦ ἀληθεστάτου καὶ πατρὸς δικαιοσύνης καὶ σωφροσύνης καὶ τῶν ἄλλων ἀρετῶν ἀνεπιμίκτου τε κακίας θεοῦ· ἀλλ᾿ ἐκεῖνόν τε καὶ παρ᾿ αὐτοῦ υἱὸν ἐλθόντα καὶ διδάξαντα ἡμᾶς ταῦτα, καὶ τὸν τῶν ἄλλων ἑπομένων καὶ ἐξομοιουμένων ἀγαθῶν ἀγγέλων στρατόν, πνεῦμά τε τὸ προφητικὸν σεβόμεθα καὶ προσκυνοῦμεν, λόγῳ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ τιμῶντες, καὶ παντὶ βουλομένῳ μαθεῖν, ὡς ἐδιδάχθημεν, ἀφθόνως παραδιδόντες.
pass_a_gloss: From this also we are called atheists; and we confess to be atheists of such gods as are thought to be, but not of the truest and Father of justice and self-control and the other virtues, unmingled with evil, God; but that one and the Son who came from Him and taught us these things, and the army of good angels who follow and are assimilated to them, and the prophetic Spirit, we reverence and worship, honoring with reason and truth, and to all who wish to learn, as we were taught, we generously impart.
pass_b_english: From this we are also called atheists. We confess that we are atheists with regard to the gods that people consider real, but not with regard to the truest God, the Father of justice, self-control, and the other virtues, a God completely unmingled with evil. We reverence and worship that God, and the Son who came from Him and taught us these things, and the army of good angels who follow and are assimilated to them, and the prophetic Spirit. We honor them with reason and truth, and we generously impart what we have learned to anyone who wishes to learn it.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the Greek text. Pass A is a faithful literal translation. Pass B is a fluent rendering that preserves all semantic content, including the distinction between the false gods and the true God, the relationship of the Son, the angelic host, and the prophetic Spirit. The translation of 'ἀνεπιμίκτου τε κακίας' as 'unmingled with evil' (A) and 'completely unmingled with evil' (B) is accurate. The translation of 'πνεῦμά τε τὸ προφητικὸν' as 'prophetic Spirit' is correct.
